text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel selecting a female candidate is not evidence of discrimination. For senior municipal roles like Director of Planning, competencies in public consultation, stakeholder engagement, and leadership style are often prioritized over technical credentials or years of service. 

Raising gender bias based solely on the panel's demographics will not overturn the outcome and will severely damage your professional reputation within municipal governance circles. 

Instead, follow up politely on your request for feedback. Frame the inquiry constructively to learn which competencies to emphasize in future interviews, particularly regarding public engagement and community relations.
